name: USB-C desk lamp
summary: 1 W LED in a printed shade on a 200 mm arm, weighted base, USB-C in and a rocker switch.

spec.name: USB-C Desk Lamp
spec.function: A small reading lamp powered over USB-C: a 1 W white LED in a printed shade hangs from a 200 mm horizontal arm on a square post, and a solid printed base keeps it standing with the head fully out over the desk.
spec.quote: Design a USB-C desk lamp with a 1 W LED on a 200 mm arm and a weighted base, under 25 euros and 450 g. It must not tip with the head fully out, and the arm must bend under 2 mm with a 3 N push.

parts.name: Weighted base
parts.description: Plate 150 mm wide (X -75 to 75), from Y=40 forwards to Y=-135, 10 mm thick (Z 0 to 10), rounded vertical corners, hollowed from below in front of the post with a 3.5 mm top skin and a 5 mm rim. An 18 mm square socket 7 mm deep at X=0, Y=20 for the post, a 13 x 9 mm rocker switch cut-out near the front and a USB-C breakout pocket from below with the socket opening in the back face.

parts.name: Post
parts.description: Square post 18 x 18 mm centred on X=0, Y=20, standing in the base socket from Z=3 to Z=275, with an 11 mm bore along its length for the LED wires.

parts.name: Arm
parts.description: Horizontal bar 16 mm wide and 13 mm tall on top of the post (Z 275 to 288), from Y=32 forwards to Y=-200, rounded long edges, with a 4 x 2.5 mm wire groove along the underside.

parts.name: Lamp head
parts.description: Open-bottom square shade 64 x 64 x 32 mm with 2 mm walls, centred on X=0, Y=-185, hanging under the arm end from Z=243 to Z=275, with two vent slots in the roof beside the arm.

parts.name: 1 W white LED
parts.description: On its 20 mm star under the shade roof, facing down

parts.name: LED series resistor 5.6 ohm 2 W
parts.description: Limits the LED to about 300 mA from 5 V

parts.name: USB-C socket breakout
parts.description: In the pocket at the back of the base

parts.name: USB-C cable and 5 V wall adapter
parts.description: Plugs into the socket at the back
parts.query: USB-C cable and 5 V 2 A wall adapter

requirements.text: Tips only beyond 15 degrees with the head fully out
requirements.quote: It must not tip with the head fully out

requirements.text: Arm bends under 2 mm with the head and a 3 N push
requirements.quote: the arm must bend under 2 mm with a 3 N push

requirements.text: Settles within 5 degrees after a 1 N push at the top
requirements.quote: It must not tip with the head fully out

led.reason: About 100 lm at 1 W is enough for a reading spot and stays cool on its star.

estimate.name: Resistor 5.6 ohm 2 W
estimate.note: A standard metal-film resistor; the catalog has no resistors, so mass and price are estimates.

resistor.reason: The catalog has no resistors; (5 V - 3.2 V) / 0.3 A is about 5.6 ohm, 0.5 W, so a 2 W part runs cool. Estimated price.

usb-c.reason: A bare USB-C socket with CC pins out, so the lamp takes any USB-C cable.

switch.reason: Snaps into the 13 x 9 mm cut-out in the base.

power.reason: 5 V 2 A covers the 1 W LED with a lot of margin.

feet.reason: Four non-slip feet keep the base from sliding.
